meanings.note: A set phrase, 1st person plural. Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'пустить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to allow; to suppose', paired with 'допускать'.

A set phrase, 1st person plural. Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'пустить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to allow; to suppose', paired with 'допускать'.

examples.text: Ну, допустим, я жулик. А ты жадина и не помогаешь людям в беде.

meanings.note: To bring an activity to an end. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'канчивать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to finish, to conclude', paired with 'закончить'.

examples.text: Марина, давай заканчивать эту опасную акцию.
